Willis Investment Counsel sold 141,900 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.40% with the market. The institutional investor held 65,500 shares of the department and specialty retail stores company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.55M, down from 207,400 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Willis Investment Counsel who had been investing in Target Corp Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $40.83 billion market cap company.
